{{Quote|As a matter of fact yes. I worked with Lepwalk C'han in the factory. I think he might know about the Oil Filtration System. Here is his current location. Tell him I said 'Hello.'|Tombl Blaus, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FonatF" />}}
'''Tombl Blaus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he stayed at a camp on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] which was the site of many [[Poacher vs. Creature Battle|battles]] between poachers and creatures, including [[vrobal]]s and vicious [[Squall (species)|squalls]]. Around this time, Blaus encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who wished to learn more about an ice cream machine.<ref name="SWG:FonatF" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tombl Blaus was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FonatF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tombl Blaus was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Portable Deep Fryer|"Portable Deep Fryer" collection]] introduced with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|Chapter 9]],"<ref>{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67692&month=042008|text=Weekly Picks – 4/3/08 - 04/03/2008}}</ref> published on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
